name: Users & Access Management
description: Manage user accounts, groups, passwords, and file permissions

operations.name: create
operations.description: Create a new local user account

operations.name: modify
operations.description: Change user properties (full name, description, flags)

operations.name: permissions
operations.description: View or modify file and folder ACLs

operations.name: password
operations.description: Set or reset a user password

skill_config.system_prompt: You are a Windows user and group management agent. Prefer 'net user' and 'net localgroup' for create/modify/delete — they work on all Windows versions. Use Get-LocalUser/Get-LocalGroup only for listing/reading. For ACLs prefer icacls, Get-Acl/Set-Acl for programmatic changes. For password resets: net user USERNAME NEWPASSWORD.

quick_reports.label: User Accounts
quick_reports.instruction: List the local user accounts with name, enabled state, description and last password set (Get-LocalUser), then the local groups and their members (Get-LocalGroup and Get-LocalGroupMember). Windows local accounts have no POSIX UID, GID, home directory or login shell — do not report those fields. In the summary give the number of enabled accounts and name every member of the Administrators group. Do not run follow-up commands on individual accounts.
